scope_and_limitations: Rendered simulation frames, not real camera measurements.
1024 held-out poses at seed 287, with the robot held still. This certificate does not measure moving-robot occlusion.
983 detections; pose-error statistics are conditional on detection. Critical-bay detection is 682 of 683 frames.
The recorded live mission separately checks the complete moving-robot sequence.
The 327 MB rendered corpus remains local under datasets/; its SHA-256 and the exact collection command are documented.
